text: Hello and welcome to live coverage of the Premier League meeting between Liverpool and Luton Town at Anfield!
This game was supposed to take place at the weekend, but due to Liverpool's involvement in the EFL Cup final on Sunday, it's been moved forward.
The Reds have the chance to extend their lead at the top of the league ahead of the rest of the fixtures and can go four points clear of Manchester City with another win here.
They've only lost one of their last 14 games in all competitions (W10 D3), but they've won back-to-back matches since their defeat to Arsenal.
Their form at home is a force to be reckoned with, though, as they haven't lost at Anfield in any of their last 24 outings there (W19 D5).
As for Luton, they've slipped back into the relegation zone after Everton's draw with Crystal Palace on Monday, but if they avoid defeat here, they'll leapfrog the Toffees once more.

After going on a six-game unbeaten run in all competitions at the start of the year (W3 D3), they've since lost their last two against Sheffield United and Manchester United, though they were unlucky to come out of the latter empty-handed.
Jurgen Klopp makes five changes from Liverpool's win over Brentford on Saturday, as Quansah, Gomez, Gravenberch, Elliott and Gakpo are all brought in.
Robertson and Konate drop to a young bench.
Diogo Jota is out with a knee injury, while Curtis Jones and Darwin Nunez aren't risked after also going off in that game.
Mohamed Salah also isn't in the squad.
Despite losing to United last time out, Rob Edwards was clearly pleased with what he saw from his team as he names an unchanged line-up here.
Woodrow continues to lead the line after Elijah Adebayo picked up a hamstring injury in the warm-up of that game.
The teams are out on the pitch now, with kick-off just moments away!
Lokonga gets the game under way for Luton!
Liverpool win an early corner and it's worked to Mac Allister on the edge of the box.
He curls an inviting cross to the far post, but Doughty heads it out for another corner.
This one comes to nothing.
Kelleher sends it long over the top and Luton switch off, allowing Diaz to run onto it on the edge of the box.
He can't get it out of his feet in time to get an early shot away though, and Mengi gets across to knock it away.
WIDE! Diaz has made a really bright start to this game, and Elliott plays it inside to him, and he just spins away from Osho to get a sight of goal.
He does get a shot away this time, but fires it wide of the far post.
After a slow start to the game, Luton are advancing forward for the first time and Ogbene gets away from two Liverpool players to hook in a cross from the right.
He's looking for Morris, but the captain can't get on the end of it.
Elliott goes out to take another corner, but it's cleared just in front of Quansah.
It only goes as far as Mac Allister, who works it back out to Elliott, but the defender is caught on his heels this time.
Chong has acres of space in the middle of the field, and he spots Doughty to his left.
He gets in front of Bradley to fizz a dangerous ball across the face of goal, but none of his team-mates are there to meet it.
GOOOAAALLL!!! OGBENE SCORES! Luton have the lead at Anfield! It comes from a throw-in on the left, and Doughty holds off Quansah to cushion it into Chong's path.
The angle is tight, but he still goes for goal.
It goes through Kelleher's legs, but the keeper gets enough on it to stop it from crossing the line.
It loops up though, and Ogbene nods it in from the far post.
1-0 Luton!
Lokonga isn't strong enough as he tries to bring down Gakpo, and he's left on the floor by the Dutchman, who drives forward.
He has options either side, but goes for goal himself, earning a corner as his shot deflects over the bar.
Luton are getting everybody back inside their own penalty area whenever Liverpool win a corner, and there's no space for the Reds.
Bradley sees a cross blocked, and Van Dijk can't pick out a team-mate when he recycles it on the opposite flank.
Doughty steps across Gravenberch to try and stop him, but when the Dutchman gets away, he also pulls him back by the arm.
The winger is shown the first yellow card of the game.
Bell's clearance is charged down by Gomez, which takes it straight to Gakpo, and he deftly flicks it into Elliott's path on the left of the box.
He can't bring it under control quickly enough though, and Lokonga takes no risks by putting his laces through the clearance.
It's a lovely throughball from Chong into the box for Woodrow, but Kelleher is alert and rushes out to intercept it.
He then throws it out to Mac Allister to set him on the counter, but he can't escape Barkley.
Luton have made a good start to this game, and Edwards will be delighted with what he's seen so far.
However, history doesn't favour them in this exact fixture, as they've never beaten Liverpool in a league game at Anfield (P14 - W8 D6).
Luton have started to get a little sloppy in the last couple of minutes, and have given it away in their own half a couple of times.
Mac Allister makes the latest interception, but his throughball to Gakpo is too close to Kaminski.
CHANCE! Gomez is allowed to advance and the Luton players just drop back, allowing him to keep going.
When he gets to the edge of the box, he tries his luck, curling his shot towards the far-top corner, but it flies wide.
SAVE! Bell carries it out from the back, only to run into Van Dijk high up the pitch, and the Liverpool captain nicks it off him before picking out Diaz's run.
He cuts inside from the left and drills his shot through Mengi's legs, but it's held by Kaminski.
Luton win a free-kick on the right, but they waste a good chance to put it into the box.
It comes back to Barkley twice after he initially takes it short, but when he switches out to the opposite flank, Dought just drifts offside.
WHAT A CHANCE! Diaz starts the move, but he has to wait a while to get it back until Endo scoops a good pass into the box.
The Colombian peels off the back of Mengi to reach it, but pokes it wide of the near post on the stretch.
Barkley's pass out to Ogbene is a bit too heavy, but the winger is able to keep it alive before returning it to the midfielder.
Barkley does swing a cross in this time, but it's a tame one that is easily caught by Kelleher.
OVER! Diaz has had all of Liverpool's best chances here, and he sees another one go begging.
Luton give it away in their own half again, with the forward driving to the edge of the box before letting fly, but his shot sails over the bar.
It's getting a bit stuck in midfield at the moment, with both sides struggling to keep hold of it for more than a couple of seconds.
Gravenberch eventually trips Chong when his frustration gets the better of him, and Luton win a free-kick.
BLOCK! It's well won back by Bradley before Mac Allister's hopeful clearance sets Gravenberch away through the middle.
He helps it out to Diaz once more, but Bell recovers brilliantly to slide in and block his latest attempt.
Another corner for the Reds is comfortably cleared by Luton, but Mac Allister manages to latch onto the second ball.
He touches it back to Elliott, who is the latest Liverpool player to have a go from range, but this one flies over the bar too.
There's a collision between Woodrow and Quansah as they go up for an aerial challenge, with the defender getting caught on the side of his head.
Woodrow is booked for the challenge.
Mac Allister nicks it off Osho on the halfway line and quickly gets it out to Diaz.
He helps it onto Elliott, who has every intention of returning the one-two, but Luton swarm around him to stop the pass from getting through.
Into the first of two added minutes here, with Liverpool still attempting to get an equaliser before the break.
Kelleher sends it long to Bradley, who flicks it onto Gakpo, but his cross is too close to Kaminski.
CHANCE! Ogbene has space to burst into down the right after knocking it past Gomez, and he curls an early cross into the box to Woodrow.
He meets it awkwardly on the volley as he jumps, but it loops over the crossbar.
HALF-TIME: LIVERPOOL 0-1 LUTON TOWN.
Ogbene's early goal gives Luton a 1-0 lead over Liverpool at half-time.

The Hatters scored just 12 minutes into the game after breezing through the Reds' defence, and Chong's tight-angled shot was saved by Kelleher, but it looped off the goalkeeper for Ogbene to head in at the far post.
Liverpool have certainly had their chances, mainly from long range, but Diaz has come closest to getting them on the scoresheet, sending two great efforts wide of Kaminski's right post.

Edwards will be thrilled with what he's seen from his side so far - despite having few chances, they've looked a threat on the break, but more importantly, they've defended as a unit to frustrate Liverpool.
Klopp didn't look too happy on the sideline, though his team did react well to going behind so early.
He'll be looking for a more clinical performance after the break, especially since he has no senior attacking options to hand on the bench.
There is a change at the break for Luton.
Lokonga is the player making way after picking up a knock in the first half, with Mpanzu on in his place.
Liverpool get us back under way for the second half!
Mengi thinks he's done enough to hold off Diaz, but a foul is actually given against the Luton man.
The Liverpool fans want a booking for the defender, but it's a member of their coaching staff who's booked for dissent for his reaction on the sidelines.
There's so much space for Elliott on the edge of the box when Endo slides it into him, but he chooses to take on another shot from range.
He drags at it, sending it well wide of the far post.
PENALTY SHOUT! Mengi makes a brilliant block to deny Diaz from a tight angle, but Liverpool quickly work it back into the box.
The Colombian looks to square it into the middle this time when it hits Osho's arm, which is just behind him, but the referee awards a corner.
Liverpool's corner causes a scramble in the box, with nobody sure where it's going to fall next.
Gakpo reacts quickest in the end to poke it towards goal, but Mpanzu clears before the offside flag goes up.
Mac Allister picks out Elliott's overlapping run down the right, and he floats a good cross into a still-crowded penalty area.
Gakpo gets a flick on, but he can't direct it towards goal.
GOOD SAVE! Chong steps in to shield it from Elliott in the box, but Gakpo is on hand to nick it off him.
He takes it around the winger before drilling a low shot at the near post, but Kaminski gets down smartly to push it wide.

GOOOAAALLL!!! VAN DIJK EQUALISES! It's been coming from Liverpool, and their captain steps up! They finally manage to make something of one of their many corners as Mac Allister whips it into the middle, and Van Dijk darts in front of his marker to meet it.
He gets power on the header, and Kaminski can't keep it out.
It's a brilliant delivery from Mac Allister as he puts it straight onto Van Dijk's head.
GOOD SAVE! Liverpool aren't letting up the pressure here, and Bradley finds a pocket of space just inside the box.
He keeps his shot low as he hits it down the middle, and Kaminski keeps it out with his feet.
Luton are making their second change in answer to that Liverpool equaliser as Woodrow is replaced by Townsend.

GOOOAAALLL!!! GAKPO SCORES! And just like that, Liverpool lead! It comes down the right side once more as it's clipped into the near post by Mac Allister, and Gakpo just peels away from his defender to meet it.
It's another great header as he flicks it past Kaminski and into the back of the net.
2-1 Liverpool!
That's two assists in just over two minutes for Mac Allister, who picks out another good cross into the box.
GREAT SAVE! Luton just can't get out of their own box at the moment, and Gakpo is in on goal again.
He surges past Bell down the right of the box, but his low shot is turned away by Kaminski for a corner.
KAMINSKI SAVES AGAIN! Mac Allister has found his range from the corner flag and he whips another wonderful cross into the box to pick out Van Dijk.
He sends another powerful header on goal, and the goalkeeper scoops it away from his line.
After a frantic spell of the game, Edwards is making another change to try and settle things in midfield.
Chong is taken off, with Jordan Clark on in his place.
Mengi has his arms around Gakpo to stop him from turning past him, and Liverpool win a free-kick.
Elliott swings it into the box, and Osho just does enough to stop it from reaching Gakpo.
CHANCE! Bradley is dispossessed on the halfway line, and Barkley sets off on a rare Luton attack in this second half.
He slides it forward for Doughty, who tries to catch out Kelleher by chipping it towards the far post from a tight angle, but it's deflected wide.
Liverpool are making their first change now, and Bradley goes off to a standing ovation from the home crowd.
He's replaced by Robertson, which means that Gomez will switch to right-back.
Osho is caught on the ball, and Gakpo profits, but his low cross is half-cleared by Mengi.
He only gets it as far as Elliott, but his pullback is too short for Diaz on the far side.
GOOOAAALLL!!! DIAZ SCORES! That should do it for Liverpool! After missing a couple of good chances in the first half, Diaz makes no mistake this time.
Luton gives it away in their own half, with Robertson cutting out a switch to Ogbene, and his interception falls to the Colombian's feet.
He drives into the box before rifling his shot past Kaminski at the near post.
3-1 Liverpool!
Robertson reads it well and was alert to dart in front of Ogbene, and cushion it into Diaz's path.
SAVE! Luton have a chance to get themselves back into this game as it's sent long to Doughty, but Kelleher rushes out to close him down.
The winger manages to square it to Townsend, but the goalkeeper quickly gets back in position to block it.

source.text: The winger manages to square it to Townsend

text: Luton's final change of the game is an enforced one.
Doughty was caught by Kelleher during that last attack when the goalkeeper closed him down, so he can't carry on.
Kabore replaces him, which will see Ogbene switch out to the left for the end of the game.
GREAT SAVE! Diaz finds space in the box once more, but with two Luton players bearing down on him, he has to take this chance quickly.
He pokes it towards the near post, and Kaminski gets down smartly to tip it away.
Barkley drags at Elliott's shoulder before sliding in from behind to nick the ball off him.
He did catch the youngster with the follow-through, and it earns him a yellow card, much to his frustration.
There's another change for Liverpool now, as Bobby Clark is brought on in place of Gravenberch.
Liverpool are just slowing the pace of the game down at the moment, and although Luton are attempting to press, it's half-hearted.
Kelleher does misplace a pass to Robertson, but Mpanzu can't make anything of it.
CHANCE! Barkley is caught on the ball in the centre circle, and Endo is quick to slide it forward to Gakpo.
He has time to take it into the box, but tries his luck from range instead, and curls it wide of the near post.
Gomez gets a handful of Ogbene's shirt, and the winger decides to pull up to show it to the referee.
It works, with Luton getting a free-kick, and Gomez getting a booking.
In Salah (19), Jota (14), Nunez (13), Gakpo (11), and Diaz (10), Liverpool are the first club in Europe's big-five leagues to have five players reach 10+ goals in all competitions this season.
Luton are enjoying a good spell of possession here, but it's all in their own half as they try to slow things down a little bit.
They're in no hurry to push forward, though Liverpool are pressing them high.
Quansah clips the back of Barkley's heel, taking his boot off, and Luton have a free-kick in a good position.
Barkley steps up to take it but curls his effort straight into the wall.
The home crowd are on their feet to give a standing ovation to the players making way.
Diaz, who scored the final goal, which looks like it will seal the three points, is replaced by Danns, who makes his debut.
And Mac Allister, who set up the first two goals, goes off for McConnell.
Kabore catches McConnell with a late tackle and becomes the fourth player to go into the referee's book.
GOOOAAALLL!!! ELLIOTT SCORES! Osho intercepts Robertson's pass, only to give it away to Danns.
He slides it into the box for Gakpo, but Mengi takes it off his toe.
Elliott races onto the loose ball and whips a shot past Kaminski and into the back of the net.
4-1 Liverpool!
We're into eight minutes of added time here as Luton attempt to pull another goal back.
Mpanzu slides it down the right for Kabore to chase, but he's caught on his heels and can't keep it in play.
Quansah is allowed to carry the ball a long way before he tries to set McConnell away down the right.
Ogbene does enough to stop that from happening but puts it straight out of play to gift possession back to Liverpool.
Luton are pushing forward again to try and give their fans something to cheer late on.
Townsend swings in a corner, but Kelleher rushes off his line to punch it away.
FULL-TIME: LIVERPOOL 4-1 LUTON TOWN.
Liverpool's brilliant second-half display sees them come from behind to beat Luton 4-1.
The visitors had a wonderful first half and took the lead just 12 minutes in as Ogbene headed in the rebound of Chong's saved effort.
The Reds pushed to equalise but couldn't find a way through a compact Luton side.
That changed after the break though, and two goals in just over two minutes flipped the game on its head.
Van Dijk levelled things up with a thumping header before Gakpo flicked in their second.

Diaz then punished Luton for giving the ball away inside their own half by rifling it into the back of the net, with Elliott rounding things off late on with a lovely curling effort in the 90th minute.
It's a win that lifts Liverpool four points clear at the top of the table, though they have played a game more than the teams below them.
Next up for them is the EFL Cup final against Chelsea on Sunday.
That loss means that Luton stay in the bottom three, and they don't play again until their FA Cup fifth-round tie against Manchester City on Tuesday.
That's all for today, goodbye!
